title: Ontario Grade 10 Principles of Mathematics (MPM2D) — Success Criteria

overalls.title: Properties of Quadratic Relations
overalls.description: determine the basic properties of quadratic relations

specifics.description: I can identify the key features of a parabola including the vertex, axis of symmetry, zeros, and intercepts.
I can explain the roles of a, h, and k in y = a(x - h)² + k and sketch graphs by applying transformations to y = x².

overalls.title: Solving Quadratic Equations
overalls.description: solve quadratic equations and interpret the solutions with respect to the corresponding relations

specifics.description: I can expand, simplify, and factor polynomial expressions including trinomials and differences of squares.
I can solve quadratic equations using factoring, completing the square, and the quadratic formula.
I can solve real-world problems involving quadratic relations, including determining maximum or minimum values.

overalls.title: Linear Systems
overalls.description: model and solve problems involving the intersection of two straight lines

specifics.description: I can solve systems of linear equations using substitution and elimination, and apply them to real-world problems.

overalls.title: Properties of Lines and Segments
overalls.description: solve problems using analytic geometry involving properties of lines and line segments

specifics.description: I can calculate the midpoint, length, and slope of a line segment and use these to solve problems.
I can develop and apply the equation of a circle centred at the origin, and solve problems involving circles.

overalls.title: Verifying Geometric Properties
overalls.description: verify geometric properties of triangles and quadrilaterals, using analytic geometry

specifics.description: I can use algebraic techniques and analytic geometry to verify geometric properties of triangles and quadrilaterals.
I can plan and carry out a multi-step analytic geometry strategy to verify a geometric property.

overalls.title: Similar Triangles
overalls.description: use their knowledge of ratio and proportion to investigate similar triangles and solve problems related to similarity

specifics.description: I can identify and apply properties of similar triangles to solve problems in realistic situations.

overalls.title: Right Triangle Trigonometry
overalls.description: solve problems involving right triangles, using the primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem

specifics.description: I can use the primary trigonometric ratios and the Pythagorean theorem to solve problems involving right triangles.

overalls.title: Acute Triangle Trigonometry
overalls.description: solve problems involving acute triangles, using the sine law and the cosine law

specifics.description: I can apply the sine law and cosine law to determine unknown sides and angles in acute triangles.
I can solve multi-step problems involving the measures of sides and angles in acute triangles.
I can explore and explain the development of the sine law and cosine law.
